description: Saves a founder’s review as a one-day draft and returns a link that opens it on programscape.com with their answers and kept programs in place. The founder saves it there with an email code (no password). The link works for 24 hours.

answers.description: The founder’s answers, keyed by question field: the shared questions’ fields or a question a review returned (e.g. "stage": "seed", "funding": ["venture"], "currentProviders": ["aws", "openai"], "companyTypes": ["ai"]). A fact the founder hasn’t given is left out and stays unknown.

inferredAnswers.description: The worked-out partner answers a saved plan returned as inferredAnswers, exactly as returned: the review reads them as Programscape worked them out, not as the founder’s own answers, and one from a list that has changed since as unanswered.

keep.description: Ids of programs the founder chose to keep. Empty or left out when they chose none.

name: save_plan_draft
title: Save the founder’s review
